Estimez vos dépenses publicitaires display avec AdClarity C'est frustrant de ne pas avoir une vision complète de ce qui se passe dans le paysage publicitaire de son marché. Savoir combien les concurrents dépensent en publicité, quand et où, offre un aperçu précieux de la façon dont votre marque devrait fonctionner (et surpasser !). Vous pouvez rechercher des données par éditeur, annonceur, campagne, mots-clés, groupes ou comparaisons. L'application fournit notamment les informations suivantes : Dépenses estimées Répartition des types d'annonces méthodes d'achat publicitaire tendances des dépenses des annonceurs Détail des dépenses Annonces principales Campagnes phares Principaux éditeurs méthodes d'achat publicitaire AdClarity peut être utilisé par toute personne possédant un compte Semrush (même un compte gratuit ou d'essai). L'application fonctionne par abonnement et les prix des forfaits varient selon le niveau choisi : publicités sur les réseaux sociaux et vidéo, publicités display ou tous les canaux publicitaires. Vous pouvez l'essayer à tout moment grâce à un essai gratuit de sept jours. Une fois dans l'application, voici comment estimer les dépenses publicitaires sur chaque canal. Estimation des dépenses publicitaires sur Google Display Avec l'abonnement aux annonces display, vous pouvez utiliser AdClarity pour déterminer combien vos concurrents dépensent pour leurs annonces Google Display . Pour commencer, cliquez sur la barre de recherche en haut de la page et saisissez des termes de recherche pertinents pour votre concurrent. Il peut s'agir du nom de votre concurrent, des titres de ses campagnes ou d'autres mots-clés. Pour l'instant, intéressons-nous aux dépenses publicitaires du supermarché britannique Tesco. Vous pouvez également sélectionner ci-dessous l'appareil, la période et le lieu sur lesquels vous souhaitez concentrer votre recherche. Ensuite, vous verrez apparaître un ensemble de données concernant les dépenses publicitaires de vos concurrents. Cela inclut les estimations de dépenses, le placement des publicités display, les méthodes d'achat d'espaces publicitaires, les tendances des dépenses des annonceurs, les meilleures publicités, les meilleures campagnes, les meilleurs éditeurs et les méthodes d'achat d'espaces publicitaires. On constate ici qu'au cours des trois derniers mois, Tesco a dépensé environ 111 900 $ pour 30,2 millions d'impressions publicitaires. La majorité de ses publicités display sont placées bien en dessous de la ligne de flottaison et l'entreprise achète principalement des publicités de manière programmatique. Le supermarché génère en moyenne 2,3 millions d'impressions hebdomadaires sur ses publicités display, pour un budget de 8 600 $ par semaine. Elle utilise également 92 de ses 102 éditeurs publicitaires par semaine. Plus bas dans le rapport, on peut voir que la publicité de Tesco la plus populaire en termes d'impressions est une publicité pour une Guinness pression à l'azote. En cliquant sur cette publicité, vous accéderez à encore plus de détails, notamment l'éditeur, la possibilité de consulter la page de destination de la campagne et un rapport complet sur cette campagne publicitaire. Vous pouvez également exporter ces informations pour vos notes marketing internes. En faisant défiler vers le bas, AdClarity révèle que la campagne phare de Tesco représente 43,18 % du total des impressions publicitaires de l'entreprise. Nous apprenons également que Tesco a dépensé 477 880 $ pour cette campagne, soit 42,8 % de son budget total. Ci-dessous, nous constatons que le journal britannique Mirror est le principal éditeur publicitaire de Tesco au cours de ces trois mois, suivi du Daily Mail et du Guardian. Enfin, l'outil souligne que la méthode d'achat publicitaire majoritaire de Tesco est programmatique (50 %). L'entreprise a dépensé 14,95 millions de dollars pour cette méthode, soit 49,53 % de son budget sur cette période. En deuxième position, on trouve les méthodes de diffusion directe (20%), puis la diffusion programmatique directe (17%), le réseau publicitaire programmatique (13%) et le réseau publicitaire (0,02%). Maintenant que nous avons un aperçu des dépenses de cette entreprise sur Google Display (environ 111 900 $ en 3 mois pour 30 millions d'impressions), nous pouvons les comparer aux autres canaux publicitaires. Estimation des dépenses publicitaires sur les réseaux sociaux Les réseaux sociaux sont une bête féroce. Cela signifie que vous pouvez identifier les domaines où la concurrence est la plus féroce et déterminer où concentrer vos dépenses publicitaires. Lorsque vous vous connectez à AdClarity, saisissez le nom de votre concurrent, votre campagne ou vos mots clés dans la barre de recherche supérieure. Sélectionnez le canal souhaité (choisissez Social), la période et le lieu. Pour cet exemple, nous prendrons Tesco. Dans la première rangée de widgets, vous verrez les dépenses estimées, l'emplacement des publicités sur les réseaux sociaux et les types de publicités sur les réseaux sociaux. Cela nous indique que Tesco a dépensé 1,9 million de dollars pour 270,7 millions d'impressions sur trois mois. Comparativement à ses dépenses sur le canal Google Display (111,9 k dollars), nous pouvons en déduire que Tesco a dépensé plus de dix fois ce budget en publicités sur les réseaux sociaux. Ce rapport souligne également que la marque a principalement utilisé le flux RSS pour ses placements publicitaires et a consacré la majeure partie de son budget publicitaire sur les réseaux sociaux aux publicités vidéo. Dans le widget des tendances de dépenses des annonceurs, AdClarity montre que Tesco a enregistré en moyenne 20,8 millions d'impressions hebdomadaires sur la période étudiée, a dépensé en moyenne 148 900 $ par semaine et n'a utilisé que cinq éditeurs par semaine (sur un total de 102). Nous apprenons également que la meilleure publicité de Tesco sur les réseaux sociaux était destinée aux chauffeurs-livreurs, ce qui a coûté 94 300 $ au supermarché et a généré 11,10 millions d'impressions. En cliquant sur la publicité, on constate qu'elle a été publiée sur Facebook. En haut de cette fenêtre, vous trouverez la possibilité de consulter le rapport complet de la campagne, d'afficher la page de destination de la campagne et d'exporter les informations publicitaires. Dans le classement des meilleures campagnes, la page Facebook de Tesco occupe la première place. Nous pouvons constater ici que le budget de cette campagne (737 790 $) représentait 38,12 % du budget publicitaire total de Tesco sur les réseaux sociaux au cours des trois mois. Enfin, il apparaît que Tesco a principalement utilisé Facebook comme plateforme publicitaire durant la période considérée. Les publicités diffusées sur cette plateforme ont généré 73,55 % de toutes les impressions publicitaires de Tesco sur les réseaux sociaux. Au total, Tesco a dépensé 199,08 millions de dollars en publicités Facebook au cours des trois derniers mois. Instagram et Pinterest étaient les deuxième et troisième réseaux sociaux les plus utilisés par Tesco pour ses publicités durant cette période. Maintenant que nous avons une idée de leurs dépenses publicitaires sur les réseaux sociaux par rapport à Google Display, examinons leurs dépenses publicitaires vidéo sur YouTube et d'autres plateformes. title: Monopar Therapeutics Reports First Quarter 2025 Financial Results and Recent Developments
body_text: Download as PDF May 13, 2025 Related Documents PDF HTML 10-Q Filing ZIP XLS HTML XBRL WILMETTE, Illinois, May 13, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Monopar Therapeutics Inc. (“Monopar” or the “Company”) (Nasdaq: MNPR), a clinical‐stage biopharmaceutical company focused on developing innovative treatments for patients with unmet medical needs, today announced first quarter 2025 financial results and recent developments. Recent Developments ALXN1840 for Wilson Disease On May 7, 2025, Monopar presented long-term efficacy and safety data for ALXN1840 (tiomolybdate choline) at the European Association for the Study of the Liver ( “ EASL ” ) International Liver Congress 2025 , a leading global conference in liver disease. The data support ALXN1840 as a potential treatment for Wilson disease , a rare genetic disorder that causes toxic copper buildup in organs like the liver and brain. Pooled results from three clinical trials (n=255) showed sustained clinical benefits over a median treatment duration of 2.63 years. Safety data, which included an additional Phase 2 study (n=266), confirmed a favorable safety profile with fewer than 5% of patients experiencing a drug-related serious adverse event (“SAE”) and no renal or urinary system SAEs . Sustained neurological improvement as assessed by the physician as well as the patient using the Unified Wilson Disease Rating Scale (“UWDRS”) was observed, as was sustained increased copper mobilization. Patients reported greater convenience and effectiveness when treated with ALXN1840 compared to standard of care, and improvement in the New Wilson Index (a prognostic indicator of the status of the liver) was also observed. The Company is preparing to submit a New Drug Application ( “ NDA ” ) to the U.S. Food and Drug Administration ( “ FDA ” ) in early 2026 . MNPR ‐ 101 for Radiopharmaceutical Use The Company’s MNPR-101-Zr Phase 1 (imaging and dosimetry) and MNPR-101-Lu (therapeutic) Phase 1a clinical trials in advanced cancers are active and enrolling in Australia. Monopar continues its preclinical work with MNPR-101-Ac (therapeutic) with plans to enter the clinic in the future. Financial Results for the First Quarter Ended March 31, 2025, Compared to the First Quarter Ended March 31, 2024 Cash and Net Loss Cash, cash equivalents and investments as of March 31, 2025, were $54.6 million. Monopar expects that its current funds will be sufficient to continue operations at least through December 31, 2026, in order to: (1) assemble a regulatory package and file an NDA for ALXN1840; (2) continue to conduct and conclude its first-in-human imaging and dosimetry clinical trial with MNPR-101-Zr; (3) continue to conduct its first-in-human therapeutic clinical trial of MNPR-101-Lu; (4) advance its preclinical MNPR-101-Ac program into the clinic; and (5) invest in internal research and development projects to expand its radiopharmaceutical and rare disease pipeline. Net loss for the first quarter of 2025 was $2.6 million or $0.38 per share compared to net loss of $1.6 million or $0.51 per share for the first quarter of 2024. Research and Development ( “ R&D ” ) Expenses R&D expenses for the first quarter of 2025 were $1,643,000, compared to $966,000 for the first quarter of 2024. This represents an increase of $677,000 attributed to (1) a $611,000 increase in R&D personnel expenses including stock-based compensation and (2) a $69,000 increase in clinical trial site activity related to MNPR-101 for radiopharmaceutical use, partially offset by (3) a net decrease of $3,000 in other R&D expenses. General and Administrative ( “ G&A ” ) Expenses G&A expenses for the first quarter of 2025 were $1,578,000, compared to $757,000 for the first quarter of 2024. This represents an increase of $821,000 primarily attributed to (1) a $416,000 increase in Board compensation resulting from the grant of stock options during the quarter ended March 31, 2025 (no stock options were granted during the quarter ended March 31, 2024), (2) a $291,000 increase in G&A personnel expenses including stock-based compensation, (3) a $73,000 increase in legal fees and (4) a $41,000 increase in insurance expenses. Interest Income Interest income for the first quarter of 2025 increased by $515,000, compared to the first quarter of 2024. The increase is attributed to interest earned on U.S. Treasury securities and higher bank balances in 2025, resulting from over $55 million of funds raised in the fourth quarter of 2024. About Monopar Therapeutics Inc. Monopar Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company with late-stage ALXN1840 for Wilson disease, and radiopharmaceutical programs including Phase 1-stage MNPR-101-Zr for imaging advanced cancers, and Phase 1a-stage MNPR-101-Lu and late preclinical-stage MNPR-101-Ac for the treatment of advanced cancers. title: Avoid Errors in Duty Drawback Claims: 6 Common Mistakes and How to Fix Them
summary: Avoid errors in duty drawback claims with this guide to the 6 most common filing mistakes.
body_text: 6. Lack of expertise or professional assistance Duty drawback isn’t something most companies handle every day, and that’s exactly why so many claims are filed incorrectly. Without a strong understanding of customs law, classification codes, documentation requirements, and filing protocols, mistakes are almost inevitable. Yet many companies assume drawback is a straightforward refund form, something that can be handed off to someone in accounting, finance, or logistics. The reality is far more complex. To avoid errors in duty drawback claims, it’s critical to have deep regulatory knowledge or a trusted partner who does. Drawback law is technical and nuanced Duty drawback is governed by Title 19 of the U.S. Code and administered through highly specific regulations from U.S. Customs and Border Protection. These rules change over time and how they’re enforced can vary based on port, officer, or claim type. Without professional expertise, companies often: Misinterpret eligibility requirements Apply the wrong HTS codes or substitution standards Fail to track claimable inventory correctly Submit incomplete or non-compliant documentation Lose claims to missed deadlines or invalid matches These aren’t just clerical errors—they’re legal and regulatory missteps that can cost you the entire refund. Filing internally often means leaving money behind Even if a claim gets accepted, many internal teams fail to maximize refund amounts. For example, they may file under direct identification when substitution could deliver higher payouts, or ignore destruction claims entirely. Some companies submit partial claims on just a handful of imports, unaware that they could have filed for five years of retroactive refunds across multiple ports. These missed opportunities add up fast, especially for high-volume importers and exporters. Brokers help, but even they have limits Working with a customs broker is a step in the right direction, but not all brokers are created equal. Some lack specialization in drawback; or only support filing without offering deeper audit preparation, compliance checks, or refund optimization. Others operate with outdated systems that require heavy manual inputs and long back-and-forth communication chains. In many cases, brokers still ask you to do most of the heavy lifting: assembling documents, tracking deadlines, managing records, and ensuring match eligibility. Why modern support matters more than ever CBP audits are increasing in recent years, and refund values are higher than ever. That means relying solely on spreadsheets or old-school brokers is no longer good enough. The combination of regulatory complexity and financial upside demands a more proactive, tech-enabled approach. Having the right expertise on your side can mean the difference between a rejected claim and a six-figure refund. How Pax combines expert support with automation Pax is more than a filing tool. We combine customs expertise, audit-ready compliance workflows, and modern software that guides you through the entire process step by step. Our platform flags errors before they happen, recommends the optimal claim type, and helps ensure you submit fully documented, maximized claims every time. We're here to make sure you avoid errors in duty drawback claims—and unlock the full value you're owed.

title: Why Students Prefer Furniture Rentals Over Buying (And Honestly, We Get It)

body_text: The Broke-and-Flexible Era of Student Life Ah, student life—the magical phase where your brain is full but your wallet is not. Although during college times, we sometimes have to do without it ( money is required for other stuff- dating, eating roadside and cheap travels ). Between overpriced hostel food ( highly compromised quality) and 10-rupee chai runs, the idea of buying furniture sounds like a mid-life luxury . But all the above mentioned gets solved with furniture on rent and appliances on rent. Because “Long-Term Investment” Is Still a Dream Money is required to acquire comfort and class, so most students settle with cheaper furniture, which is more of a burden than convenience. Furniture made with poor alignments, unstable assembly, and inexpensive raw materials can frustrate anybody in only a few weeks. Escape all this by renting grid-quality furniture without worrying about cost. Also, there is no hassle of picking it up or reselling it. Your furniture rental package has got everything covered. And guess what? Some platforms even throw in free delivery, setup, and maintenance . Ever tried Cityfurnish. Click the link below to check. 👉 Explore student-friendly rental options here 3. PGs and Rentals Are a Match Made in Budget Heaven NO more unwanted shackles. Most PGs give you the bare minimum—a bed that squeaks, a plastic chair, and a cupboard that rattles at the hinges. A short-term internship, or a three year grad programme, either way, these squeaky sounds, worn out surfaces and broken legs are not welcome. Renting lets you upgrade your lifestyle without upgrading your EMIs. Want a better mattress? A desk to cram for CAT? A microwave to feel some independence? Rent it. Enjoy it. Return it. Unsolicited life advice #2 : Microwaves are not for making Maggi, but you’ll do it anyway. 4. The Ghar-Jaisa Comfort Without Ghar-Jaisa Expense Homesickness is real. Mother cooking in the kitchen, peeking over our shoulders wishing we would take one extra bite than yesterday. Father always remembers our favourites to pick up on his way back from work in the evening. Summer vacations, family gatherings and homemade food, how much do we sacrifice to become someone, something? But we need not to sacrifice comfort and convenience. While a rented sofa won’t hug you like mom, it will give you a place to cry during exam season. With comfy and familiar furniture, you can turn even a drab PG room into a cosy den. Add some fairy lights and boom—you’re suddenly “coping”. The Smarter, Cheaper, Less-Drama Option Let’s not overthink it— furniture rentals are a no-brainer for students . You save money, skip the logistics headache, and live smarter, not harder. Whether you’re in Bangalore, Pune, or shifting between five cities during your MBA, rentals adapt to your chaos. So no, you don’t need to buy that ₹8,000 study table. Rent it. Use it. And return it like the emotionally unavailable ex you thought you could change. Clean. Affordable. title: TDAM and iCapital Network Have Collaborated to Bring a Global Infrastructure Strategy to Eligible Canadian Accredited Investors
summary: New iCapital fund provides access to a portfolio of direct private infrastructure assets
body_text: New iCapital fund provides access to a portfolio of direct private infrastructure assets. TORONTO, May 7, 2025 /CNW/ - TD Asset Management Inc. ("TDAM") today announced a new way for investors to access private global infrastructure investments. Eligible Canadian accredited investors will now have access to TDAM's institutionally available infrastructure strategy, the TD Greystone Infrastructure Fund (Canada) L.P. (the "Institutional Fund"), through a collaboration with iCapital Network Canada Ltd. ("iCapital Canada"), a global financial technology platform driving access to alternative investments for the wealth and asset management industries. The TD Greystone Infrastructure iCapital Canada Access Fund (the "Access Fund"), managed by iCapital Canada, invests substantially all its assets in TDAM's Institutional Fund and is available to eligible Canadian accredited investors. Private Infrastructure is a growing part of institutional and high-net-worth portfolios that can provide diversification benefits, enhanced returns, lower volatility and inflation protection. TDAM's Institutional Fund has a 10+ year track record and a portfolio of private infrastructure assets with over 500 projects across 7 countries. The Institutional Fund invests in infrastructure that delivers essential services for an economy offering accredited investors potential stability and growth during times of uncertainty and over the long-term. "At a time of global uncertainty, we are excited to work with iCapital to provide access to our institutional portfolio of infrastructure assets to eligible Canadian accredited investors and advisor-led market. We have been managing the Institutional Fund for more than 10 years and have built a high-quality portfolio of private infrastructure that can provide inflation protection, long-term contracted revenues and diversification, benefiting client portfolios. We believe this structure allows retail investors to participate alongside institutions with the same underlying infrastructure portfolio and assets," said Jeffrey Mouland, Managing Director, Head of Global Infrastructure Investments, TDAM. "We're thrilled to collaborate with TDAM to provide eligible Canadian accredited investors with easy and transparent access to alternatives," said Tom Johnston, Managing Director, Head of Client Solutions Canada at iCapital. "This collaboration solidifies iCapital's position as a trusted technology partner to deliver a comprehensive digital investing experience for Canada's leading wealth advisors and asset managers." TDAM's infrastructure investment team takes a hands-on approach to provide a portfolio of operating infrastructure, with potential for long-term revenues and inflation protection. They have significant experience in private infrastructure and actively manage the portfolio through oversight of development, construction, and procurement activities, board representation, as well as financing. The Access Fund provides access to the Institutional Fund which provides diversification across each of these projects and creates what we believe is an attractive allocation to the infrastructure asset class for investment portfolios. The TD Greystone Infrastructure Fund is comprised of the TD Greystone Infrastructure Fund (Global Master) SCSp, the TD Greystone Infrastructure Fund (Canada) L.P., the TD Greystone Infrastructure Fund (Canada) L.P. II, the TD Greystone Infrastructure Fund (Cayman Feeder) L.P. and the TD Greystone Infrastructure Fund (Luxembourg Feeder) SCSp. Each of the Feeder Funds act as a feeder fund in a master-feeder structure and invests all or substantially all of its assets in the TD Greystone Infrastructure Fund (Global Master) SCSp. The Master Fund is priced monthly in USD and includes any working capital within the Master Fund, as well as the current USD value of the most recent valuation of the underlying investments. Valuations of the investments held in the Master Fund are done on a quarterly basis in the local currency of the investment. Interim valuations may be done as the result of specific situations. At each monthly pricing period, the investment valuations are converted to USD at the rate in effect of the pricing date. Effective February 1, 2024, the Master Fund redomiciled from the Cayman Islands to Luxembourg. Historical performance prior to that time reflects the performance of the TD Greystone Infrastructure Fund (Global Master) L.P. Thereafter, the performance reflects the TD Greystone Infrastructure Fund (Global Master) SCSp. The Feeder Funds are priced monthly in U.S. dollars and include working capital held within the Feeder Funds as well as the updated monthly value of the units held in the Master Fund. The value of the Feeder Funds investment in the Master Fund is determined based on the updated monthly price of the Master Fund. ®The TD logo and other TD trademarks are the property of The Toronto-Dominion Bank or its subsidiaries. About TD Asset Management Inc. TD Asset Management Inc. ("TDAM"), a member of TD Bank Group, is a North American investment management firm. TDAM offers investment solutions to corporations, pension funds, endowments, foundations and individual investors. Additionally, TDAM manages assets on behalf of almost 2 million retail investors and offers a broadly diversified suite of investment solutions including mutual funds, professionally managed portfolios and corporate class funds. Asset management businesses at TD manage $496 billion in assets. Aggregate statistics are as of March 31, 2025 for TDAM and Epoch Investment Partners, Inc. TDAM operates in Canada and Epoch Investment Partners, Inc. operates in the United States. Both entities are affiliates and are wholly-owned subsidiaries of The Toronto-Dominion Bank. About iCapital iCapital powers the world's alternative investment marketplace, offering a complete suite of tools, end-to-end enterprise solutions, data management and distribution capabilities, and an innovative operating system. iCapital is the trusted technology partner to financial advisors, wealth managers, asset managers, as well as other participants in this ecosystem, and offers unrivaled access, technology, and education to incorporate alternative assets into core portfolio strategies for their clients. As of February 28, 2025, iCapital had USD $880 billion of global volume activity on its platform. title: Trust changes everything: Insights from our 2025 leadership report
summary: Trust drives transformation. Torch’s 2025 report shows how leadership rooted in trust accelerates AI success.
body_text: Companies racing to adopt AI are missing something big. Our research shows the real advantage isn’t the tech itself—it’s the trust that makes transformation possible. We spoke with 568 leaders across industries and roles. We didn’t ask what sounds good in the boardroom—we asked what’s actually happening on the ground. The data tells a clear story. Human connection, communication, and trust separate leaders who bring people with them from those who leave teams stuck in uncertainty. Leaders who trust their senior executives are 2.2x more likely to feel excited—not anxious—about AI adoption. **What does this mean for you? **Organizations need to rethink leadership and put people at the center of AI . This creates the advantage that matters most: a leadership system that evolves faster than the world around it. Trust powers better tech adoption Across our research, one factor kept showing up. Trust between leadership levels makes or breaks change efforts. Leaders who build transparency, encourage experimentation, and connect diverse perspectives set their teams up for success. Without these foundations, even the most expensive tech investments are at risk of falling flat. *“My boss allows us to have the independence to choose our own path while offering a protective, learning environment when we make mistakes. It promotes growth and understanding.” *—Survey respondent, Director, Transportation & Logistics The answer? Design small, low-risk projects where teams can experiment with AI applications. Set clear goals, provide resources, and define success upfront. When things go wrong—and they will—treat them as learning moments, not failures. The best tech adoption happens when people feel safe to ask questions. Leaders who stay open to feedback and resist defensiveness build teams that tackle complexity together. Why trust is your real AI advantage Run short, structured check-ins where teams can raise concerns about new technologies. Creating this space helps teams move forward together, not shut down. Our research shows that teams who trust their leaders are far more likely to embrace AI as a positive force for growth. At Torch, our coaching approach has always started here—building trust, navigating complexity, and strengthening adaptive leadership . This research confirms what we see every day: The leadership capacities that build trust and resilience matter more than any technical skill when it comes to making change stick. The director squeeze is real Imagine you’re a director. You’ve just left another executive meeting about your company’s ambitious AI rollout. You’re already dreading the questions you know are coming. Your team has been through three reorgs this year alone. You already know exactly who’s going to ask, “Is my job safe?” And you still don’t have a clear answer yourself. This is the reality our research uncovered. “Constantly shifting priorities and reorgs have thrown off our team dynamics. It’s hard to deliver something with real quality when there’s no time—especially when focus shifts before we’re done. AI feels like a big opportunity, but getting alignment across leaders and teams? That part feels almost impossible.” —Survey respondent, Director, Agriculture Technology & Engineering Here’s what the data makes impossible to ignore: Nearly 60% of C-suite leaders say their teams are ready for change. But more than 40% of individual contributors report feeling resistant to it. Directors report “ongoing change” as their top challenge—at nearly four times the rate of senior executives. Directors are stuck in the middle, expected to bridge the gap between leadership optimism and team reality. The real risk of falling behind “I felt isolated, disconnected, and peripheral to the core goals of the company. I tried to connect my day-to-day work to the company goals but they shifted so often it left me (and my team) feeling disconnected.” — Survey respondent, CISO, Technology & Engineering This isn’t new. But the pressure today is higher than ever. Over **26% **of all survey respondents (and nearly 40% of Technology & Engineering leaders) said “leading with confidence through the rise of AI and new technologies” is their biggest challenge right now. When leadership fails at the human level, disconnect and distrust grow. Burnout spikes. Innovation stalls. Your best people quietly start looking for a way out. The combination of ever-changing technology and persistent people challenges creates real problems for organizations that fail to address the trust gap. What’s at stake This isn’t just about better meetings or smoother projects. The stakes go far deeper. High-trust organizations: A director hears about a new AI tool. She trusts leadership enough to ask tough questions. She gets the clarity she needs to support her team. They move forward together—engaged, even when it’s messy. Low-trust organizations: A director gets an email about a new AI tool. With no context and no safe space to ask questions, he stays quiet. His team spirals into worry and frustration. Progress stalls before it even starts. Your competitive advantage isn’t your tech. It’s your people —and their trust in you. Where leadership goes from here Leadership has never been easy—but today’s pace of change makes it harder than ever to get right. And yet, leaders remain optimistic about using new tools, especially AI, to make better decisions and drive real impact. The Leadership Evolution Report 2025 reveals what’s really going on beneath the surface—and what it’ll take to build leadership that can keep up. Inside, you’ll find: What successful leaders have in common beyond traditional skills How to close the gap between leadership levels The five shifts your leadership system needs to make now Top growth priorities for leaders in 2025 If your teams are already feeling the strain, this isn’t the moment to wait and see. The organizations that thrive in five years won’t be the ones with the most AI—they’ll be the ones with leaders who know how to navigate change and bring people with them. Want to know what that looks like? Download the full report to find out.

title: PLP AND LIGHTERA ANNOUNCE GROUNDBREAKING COMPATIBILITY PROGRAM FOR FTTX CLOSURES AND ROLLABLE RIBBON CABLE
summary: PLP transmission, distribution, substation, fiber optic, solar, and EV solutions protect and connect overhead electric power lines and communications networks.
body_text: May 29, 2025 PLP, a global leader in broadband connectivity solutions, and Lightera, a global innovator in optical fiber technology, today announced a new compatibility program that pairs PLP’s drop closures with Lightera’s rollable ribbon fiber optic cable, streamlining design and deployment strategies for FTTx networks. This new collaboration provides a groundbreaking approach to fiber network design by enabling fiber-dense cables (144-288 fibers) to be deployed using compact closures in small handholes, significantly reducing labor requirements, material costs, and installation space needed for last-mile deployments. “Rollable ribbon cable technology was initially developed for high-density applications like data centers,” said Mark Boxer, Technical Manager, Solutions and Applications Engineering at Lightera. This collaboration takes that same high-efficiency design and applies it to FTTx networks, unlocking new potential for compact, cost-conscious fiber installations.” Lightera's Rollable Ribbon Cable technology. The compatibility program combines PLP’s COYOTE® STP Pro Series ( XL and L ) and COYOTE® DTC closures with Lightera’s DuctSaver® and AccuRoll® rollable ribbon cables. When used with smaller handholes, the combination of PLP’s closures and Lightera’s cables offers a highly scalable and cost-effective alternative to traditional loose tube or flat ribbon deployments that require larger dome-style closures and handholes. Taking this approach can result in a 30% cost reduction for the distribution portion of the network versus more traditional methods. “As the demand for fiber continues to grow, network designers need smarter, more flexible deployment options,” said Matt Becker, Director of North America Communications Markets at PLP. “This program gives our customers a new level of design agility, delivering high fiber counts in smaller, more efficient packages that reduce overall build costs without compromising performance.” PLP's COYOTE® STP-XL Closure shown with four splice trays, butt spliced with Lightera's innovative 144-count AccuRoll® DC Rollable Ribbon Cable. PLP and Lightera will showcase the combined solution at Fiber Connect 2025 in Nashville, June 1-4. For more information, visit plp.com and lightera.com . ADDITIONAL RESOURCES Press Release ABOUT PLP PLP protects the world’s most critical connections by creating stronger and more reliable networks. The company’s precision-engineered solutions are trusted by energy and communications providers worldwide to perform better and last longer. With locations in over 20 countries, PLP works as a united global corporation, delivering high-quality products and unparalleled service to customers around the world. ABOUT LIGHTERA Lightera is a global leader in optical fiber and connectivity solutions, delivering innovative technologies that drive communication networks, data centers, and specialty photonics applications. With a deep legacy of expertise in optical science, we provide high-performance solutions that enable faster, more reliable, and more sustainable connections for businesses, communities, and industries worldwide. Headquartered in Norcross, Georgia, U.S.A., Lightera operates with a global footprint, serving customers across telecommunications, enterprise, industrial, generative AI, data centers, 5G/6G, utilities, medical, aerospace, defense, and sensing markets. Lightera is part of Furukawa Electric Group, a multi-billion-dollar leader in optical communications. title: PDD Holdings Announces First Quarter 2025 Unaudited Financial Results
summary: DUBLIN and SHANGHAI, May 27, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- PDD Holdings Inc. (“PDD Holdings” or the “Company”) (NASDAQ: PDD), today announced its unaudited financial results for the first quarter ended March 31, 2025. First Quarter 2025 Highlights Total revenues in the quarter were RMB95,672.2 million
body_text: PDF Version DUBLIN and SHANGHAI, May 27, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- PDD Holdings Inc. (“PDD Holdings” or the “Company”) (NASDAQ: PDD), today announced its unaudited financial results for the first quarter ended March 31, 2025. First Quarter 2025 Highlights Total revenues in the quarter were RMB95,672.2 million (US$1 13,184.0 million), an increase of 10% from RMB86,812.1 million in the same quarter of 2024. Operating profit in the quarter was RMB16,085.6 million (US$2,216.7 million), a decrease of 38% from RMB25,973.7 million in the same quarter of 2024. Non-GAAP 2 operating profit in the quarter was RMB18,259.7 million (US$2,516.3 million), a decrease of 36% from RMB28,552.2 million in the same quarter of 2024. Net income attributable to ordinary shareholders in the quarter was RMB14,741.8 million (US$2,031.5 million), a decrease of 47% from RMB27,997.8 million in the same quarter of 2024. Non-GAAP net income attributable to ordinary shareholders in the quarter was RMB16,916.0 million (US$2,331.1 million), a decrease of 45% from RMB30,601.8 million in the same quarter of 2024. “In the first quarter, we made substantial investments in our platform ecosystem to support merchants and consumers amid rapid changes in the external environment,” said Mr. Lei Chen, Chairman and Co-Chief Executive Officer of PDD Holdings. “These investments weighed on short-term profitability but gave merchants the room to adapt and focus on high-quality, sustainable growth, strengthening the long-term health of the platform.” “Amid growing uncertainties, we see enhanced merchant support as essential to building a healthy merchant ecosystem that can deliver satisfactory shopping experiences for consumers,” said Mr. Jiazhen Zhao, Executive Director and Co-Chief Executive Officer of PDD Holdings. “That is why we have made the strategic decision to increase our ecosystem investments to help drive sales and reduce costs for a broader base of SME merchants.” “As communicated previously, a slowdown in growth rate is expected as our business scales and challenges emerge. This trend has been further accelerated by the changes in the external environment in the first quarter,” said Ms. Jun Liu, VP of Finance of PDD Holdings. “Our financial results may continue to reflect the impact of sustained investments in the ecosystem as we support merchants and consumers through uncertain times.” _____________________________ 1 This announcement contains translations of certain Renminbi (“RMB”) amounts into U.S. dollars (“US$”) at a specified rate solely for the convenience of the reader. Unless otherwise noted, the translation of RMB into US$ has been made at RMB7.2567 to US$1.00, the noon buying rate in effect on March 31, 2025 as set forth in the H.10 Statistical Release of the Federal Reserve Board. 2 The Company’s non-GAAP financial measures exclude share-based compensation expenses and fair value change of certain investments. See “Reconciliation of Non-GAAP Measures to the Most Directly Comparable GAAP Measures” set forth at the end of this press release. First Quarter 2025 Unaudited Financial Results Total revenues were RMB95,672.2 million (US$13,184.0 million), an increase of 10% from RMB86,812.1 million in the same quarter of 2024. The increase was primarily due to the increase in revenues from online marketing services and transaction services. Revenues from online marketing services and others were RMB48,722.2 million (US$6,714.1 million), an increase of 15% from RMB42,456.2 million in the same quarter of 2024. Revenues from transaction services were RMB46,950.0 million (US$6,469.9 million), an increase of 6% from RMB44,355.8 million in the same quarter of 2024. Total costs of revenues were RMB40,947.1 million (US$5,642.7 million), an increase of 25% from RMB32,694.7 million in the same quarter of 2024. The increase mainly came from the increased fulfilment fees and payment processing fees. Total operating expenses were RMB38,639.5 million (US$5,324.7 million), an increase of 37% from RMB28,143.7 million in the same quarter of 2024. The increase was primarily due to the increase in sales and marketing expenses. Sales and marketing expenses were RMB33,402.7 million (US$4,603.0 million), an increase of 43% from RMB23,410.7 million in the same quarter of 2024, mainly due to the increased spending in promotion and advertising activities. General and administrative expenses were RMB1,658.9 million (US$228.6 million), compared with RMB1,823.4 million in the same quarter of 2024. Research and development expenses were RMB3,577.8 million (US$493.0 million), compared with RMB2,909.6 million in the same quarter of 2024. Operating profit in the quarter was RMB16,085.6 million (US$2,216.7 million), a decrease of 38% from RMB25,973.7 million in the same quarter of 2024. Non-GAAP operating profit in the quarter was RMB18,259.7 million (US$2,516.3 million), a decrease of 36% from RMB28,552.2 million in the same quarter of 2024. Net income attributable to ordinary shareholders in the quarter was RMB14,741.8 million (US$2,031.5 million), a decrease of 47% from RMB27,997.8 million in the same quarter of 2024. Non-GAAP net income attributable to ordinary shareholders in the quarter was RMB16,916.0 million (US$2,331.1 million), a decrease of 45% from RMB30,601.8 million in the same quarter of 2024. Basic earnings per ADS was RMB10.59 (US$1.46) and diluted earnings per ADS was RMB9.94 (US$1.37), compared with basic earnings per ADS of RMB20.33 and diluted earnings per ADS of RMB18.96 in the same quarter of 2024. Non-GAAP diluted earnings per ADS was RMB11.41 (US$1.56), compared with RMB20.72 in the same quarter of 2024. Net cash generated from operating activities was RMB15,516.9 million (US$2,138.3 million), compared with RMB21,067.2 million in the same quarter of 2024. Cash, cash equivalents and short-term investments were RMB364.5 billion (US$50.2 billion) as of March 31, 2025, compared with RMB331.6 billion as of December 31, 2024. Other non-current assets were RMB76.2 billion (US$10.5 billion) as of March 31, 2025, compared with RMB83.4 billion as of December 31, 2024, which mainly included time deposits, held-to-maturity debt securities, and available-for-sale debt securities. Conference Call The Company’s management will hold an earnings conference call at 7:30 AM ET on May 27, 2025 (12:30 PM IST and 7:30 PM HKT on the same day). The conference call will be webcast live at https://investor.pddholdings.com/investor-events . The webcast will be available for replay at the same website following the conclusion of the call. Use of Non-GAAP Financial Measures In evaluating the business, the Company considers and uses non-GAAP measures, such as non-GAAP operating profit, non-GAAP net income attributable to ordinary shareholders, non-GAAP diluted earnings per ordinary share, and non-GAAP diluted earnings per ADS, as supplemental measures to review and assess operating performance. The presentation of these non-GAAP financial measures is not intended to be considered in isolation or as a substitute for the financial information prepared and presented in accordance with accounting principles generally accepted in the United States of America (“U.S. GAAP”). The Company presents these non-GAAP financial measures because they are used by management to evaluate operating performance and formulate business plans. The Company believes that the non-GAAP financial measures help identify underlying trends in its business by excluding the impact of share-based compensation expenses and fair value change of certain investments, which are non-cash charges. The Company also believes that the non-GAAP financial measures may provide further information about the Company’s results of operations, and enhance the overall understanding of the Company’s past performance and future prospects. The Company’s non-GAAP financial measures are not defined under U.S. GAAP and are not presented in accordance with U.S. GAAP. The non-GAAP financial measures have limitations as analytical tools. These non-GAAP financial measures do not reflect all items of income and expenses that affect the Company’s operations and do not represent the residual cash flow available for discretionary expenditures. Further, these non-GAAP measures may differ from the non-GAAP information used by other companies, including peer companies, and therefore their comparability may be limited. The Company compensates for these limitations by reconciling the non-GAAP financial measures to the nearest U.S. GAAP performance measure, all of which should be considered when evaluating performance. title: Claim Health Launches on Y Combinator
body_text: Claim Health Launches on Y Combinator Claim Health officially launched on Y Combinator, introducing its AI-powered platform designed to support at-home care providers navigating increasing operational complexity. The launch highlights Claim Health's mission to help home health and hospice agencies modernize admissions by reducing manual work, improving operational visibility, and getting patients into care faster. As at-home care continues to grow in importance, providers are under mounting pressure from staffing shortages, fragmented referral sources, and outdated back-office systems. title: Otras preguntas frecuentes: ¿Qué es y cómo optimizarlo?
summary: La función "Otras preguntas de los usuarios" (PAA, por sus siglas en inglés) es una función de Búsqueda de Google que muestra preguntas relacionadas con la consulta de búsqueda del usuario.
body_text: Hemos traducido este artículo del inglés al español. Haz clic aquí para leer el artículo original. Si detectas algún problema en el contenido, no dudes en escribirnos a report-osteam@semrush.com . ¿Qué es "Otras preguntas de la gente"? La función "Otras preguntas de los usuarios" (PAA, por sus siglas en inglés) es una función de búsqueda de Google que muestra preguntas relacionadas con la consulta de búsqueda inicial del usuario. Y suele aparecer cerca de la parte superior de las páginas de resultados de los motores de búsqueda (SERP). Esta función ayuda a los usuarios a encontrar más información sobre su tema sin tener que realizar búsquedas adicionales. Al hacer clic en una pregunta de PAA, se abre para mostrar una respuesta breve. Y para cada respuesta en "Otras preguntas de los usuarios", Google ha obtenido la información de una página web específica que puedes visitar para obtener más información. A veces, es posible que veas un párrafo simple. Pero la respuesta también podría incluir una lista con viñetas, una tabla, una imagen o incluso un vídeo. ¿Por qué es importante la sección "Otras preguntas de los usuarios" de Google? . De esta forma, los usuarios podrán encontrar lo que necesitan de manera más eficiente. Esto representa una oportunidad para los propietarios de sitios web y los especialistas en SEO. Porque si tu sitio web aparece tanto en los resultados de búsqueda regulares como en los recuadros de PAA, puedes obtener mayor visibilidad. Lo cual puede traducirse en mayores ingresos. Esto es especialmente cierto si se tiene en cuenta que los cuadros de "Otras preguntas de la gente" aparecen en el 51,85 % de todas las búsquedas, según datos de Semrush Sensor de agosto de 2024. Los cuadros PAA también son útiles para encontrar nuevas palabras clave a las que dirigir tu contenido. Para ayudarte a atraer más visitantes que buscan información específica. Cómo encontrar personas que también hacen preguntas Existen varios métodos para descubrir preguntas de PAA relacionadas con temas que ya has tratado o que planeas tratar: Utiliza la herramienta Keyword Magic de Semrush La herramienta Keyword Magic Tool de Semrush es un recurso poderoso para descubrir preguntas PAA relacionadas con términos para los que aún no tiene contenido. Para empezar, introduce una palabra clave general relacionada con tu marca junto con tu nombre de dominio. Y haga clic en “ Buscar .” La herramienta generará una lista de palabras clave relacionadas. Y muestra una puntuación de Dificultad Personal de Palabras Clave (PKD %) para cada una, que indica la dificultad que tendrá tu dominio específico para posicionarse para esos términos. Haga clic en el menú desplegable “ Filtros avanzados ”, seleccione el menú desplegable “ Cualquiera ” en “Funciones de la SERP” y marque la casilla junto a “Preguntas relacionadas de los usuarios”. A continuación, haga clic en “ Aplicar .” Ahora solo verás los términos que activan las casillas PAA. Elige una palabra clave principal (la palabra clave principal en la que se centrará tu contenido) teniendo en cuenta cuántas búsquedas mensuales recibe y la probabilidad de que tu empresa se posicione bien para ella. Para ver las preguntas de "Otras personas también preguntan" para la palabra clave seleccionada, haga clic en el icono situado a la izquierda de la columna "SF". En la vista previa de la página de resultados del motor de búsqueda (SERP) que aparece, analice la sección "Otras preguntas de los usuarios" para ver las preguntas que aparecen. Luego puedes incorporar esas preguntas y sus respuestas dentro de tu contenido. Más adelante en este artículo explicaremos cómo hacerlo. Utilice la herramienta de investigación orgánica de Semrush. La herramienta Investigación Orgánica te permite ver las palabras clave por las que ya apareces en los resultados de búsqueda, pero no en las secciones de PAA. Y esas son valiosas oportunidades para ampliar tu visibilidad. Abre la herramienta, introduce tu nombre de dominio y haz clic en “ Buscar .” Luego, vaya a la pestaña “ Posiciones ”. Haz clic en el menú desplegable “Funciones SERP”, elige “ El dominio no se clasifica ”, y selecciona “ Los usuarios también preguntan ”. Esto te mostrará las palabras clave en las que apareces en los resultados de búsqueda regulares, pero no en los recuadros de PAA. Para cada una de estas palabras clave, revise las preguntas actuales de PAA que aparecen en los resultados de búsqueda. Comprueba si tu contenido ya incluye y responde a estas preguntas. De lo contrario, deberás actualizar tu contenido. Utiliza la búsqueda de Google. Otro método eficaz para encontrar preguntas sobre PAA es simplemente utilizando la búsqueda de Google. Solo tienes que introducir el tema en la barra de búsqueda y pulsar buscar. En la página de resultados, busca la sección "Otras preguntas de los usuarios" con algunas preguntas. Haz clic en una de estas preguntas y verás otras preguntas relacionadas. Puedes seguir haciendo clic en las preguntas para descubrir aún más consultas relacionadas. Use AlsoAsked AlsoAsked es una herramienta de palabras clave diseñada especialmente para encontrar preguntas de otras personas. Introduce tu tema en la barra de búsqueda y haz clic en “ Buscar .” La herramienta generará un mapa visual de las preguntas relacionadas que la gente está haciendo sobre tu tema. Cada nodo del mapa representa una pregunta, y puedes hacer clic en cualquier nodo para ampliarla. Para revelar preguntas adicionales asociadas con la consulta original. Cómo optimizar tu contenido para las secciones de "Otras preguntas" Ahora que hemos explorado cómo encontrar las preguntas de "Otras preguntas de los usuarios", vamos a profundizar en cómo utilizar estas preguntas de forma eficaz en tu contenido. Así podrás aumentar tu visibilidad en los resultados de búsqueda. 1. Incluir preguntas de la PAA como títulos y subtítulos. Los títulos y subtítulos (H1, H2, H3, etc.) le indican a Google qué temas abarca su contenido. Al incorporar preguntas PAA como subtítulos, le indicas claramente a Google que tu contenido es relevante para esas consultas. Lo cual aumenta las posibilidades de que tu contenido aparezca en los recuadros de PAA. 2. Responda directamente a las preguntas. Intenta responder a las preguntas de la forma más directa posible para que a Google le resulte más fácil relacionar tu contenido con la pregunta. Y aumenta la probabilidad de que tu contenido sea seleccionado como respuesta. Por ejemplo, la Asociación Americana de Osteopatía responde a la pregunta de la PAA "¿Cuáles son los beneficios del yoga?" con una lista clara de beneficios. 3. Alinearse con el formato existente Las respuestas a las preguntas de evaluación de desempeño (PAA) pueden presentarse en diversos formatos, como párrafos, listas con viñetas y listas numeradas. Por lo tanto, es una buena idea analizar el formato de las respuestas actuales. Por ejemplo, esta respuesta se presenta como un párrafo breve. Eso significa que debes intentar replicar ese estilo en tu contenido. Para aumentar tus posibilidades de aparecer en el recuadro de PAA. 4. Optimiza tus imágenes En ocasiones, las respuestas de PAA incluyen imágenes. Y optimizar tus imágenes aumenta las posibilidades de que aparezcan destacadas. Aquí tienes dos buenas prácticas para optimizar imágenes: Utiliza texto alternativo descriptivo. Asegúrese de que cada imagen tenga texto alternativo que describa con precisión lo que es la imagen. Esto ayuda a Google a comprender el contexto de la imagen. Elija nombres de archivo informativos. Utilice nombres de archivo descriptivos como "beneficios-del-yoga.jpg" (en lugar de nombres genéricos como "IMG1234.jpg") para indicar cuál es el contenido de la imagen. Aumente su visibilidad a través de cajas PAA Aparecer en las secciones de "Otras preguntas de los usuarios" te ayuda a llegar a más personas de las que podrías llegar de otra manera. Lo que se traduce en más tráfico y posiblemente más ingresos. El primer paso es determinar qué preguntas de la PAA incluir en su contenido. Lo cual puedes hacer con la herramienta mágica de palabras clave . Pruébalo hoy mismo.

title: Sourcebot vs OpenGrok
summary: An in-depth comparison of the code search capabilities of Sourcebot and OpenGrok.
body_text: Sourcebot vs OpenGrok If you notice anything on this page that is inaccurate, please reach out to us at team@sourcebot.dev You can try out Sourcebot with our public demo How is Sourcebot different? Simpler installation and maintenance OpenGrok Setup requires you to manually install several dependencies (Java, ctags, Python, etc), clone the repo, manually deploy a web application using Tomcat, and then manually clone and index all of the repos you want to search through No automatic reindexing, you need to setup your own cron job Branches must be cloned and indexed manually Every new repo you want to search through must be manually cloned and indexed Known issues with handling large repositories Sourcebot Setup by defining a config JSON file and running a docker container. Automatically clones and indexes the repos in the config and spins up a webapp for you to begin searching immediately Fetches updates and reindexes repos automatically Branches are easily defined in the config file and automatically cloned and indexed New repos are indexed by adding them to the config file Easily handles thousands of repos of all sizes Modern UI OpenGrok Legacy UI built in Java Requires you to specify which project(s) you want to search in No information on which repos or languages were hit Auth must be configured manually Sourcebot Modern UI built with next.js No need to specify which projects you want to search across Built-in file viewer while navigating search results Built-in auth layer Ability to highlight and create a permalink to code snippets Ability to filter results by repository and/or language Product comparison Sourcebot OpenGrok Free to deploy ✅ ✅ Self hostable ✅ ✅ Regex search ✅ Only wildcards Blame/history support coming soon ✅ Search based go-to definition ✅ ✅ Automatic repo indexing support ✅ ❌ Modern UI ✅ ❌ Active feature roadmap ✅ ❌ Filter by repo/language ✅ ❌ Automatic branch indexing support ✅ ❌ Built-in authentication ✅ ❌ Permalink code snippets ✅ ❌

title: Golden Heaven Group Holdings Ltd. Announces 25 for 1 Share Consolidation
summary: NANPING, China , May 6, 2025 /PRNewswire/ -- Golden Heaven Group Holdings Ltd. ("Golden Heaven" or the "Company") (Nasdaq: GDHG), an amusement park operator in China, today announced that the Company's board of directors approved on April 23, 2025 that the authorized, issued, and outstanding shares
body_text: NANPING, China , May 6, 2025 /PRNewswire/ -- Golden Heaven Group Holdings Ltd. ("Golden Heaven" or the "Company") (Nasdaq: GDHG), an amusement park operator in China, today announced that the Company's board of directors approved on April 23, 2025 that the authorized, issued, and outstanding shares of the Company be consolidated on a 25 for 1 ratio with the marketplace effective date of May 9, 2025. The objective of the share consolidation is to enable the Company to regain compliance with Nasdaq Marketplace Rule 5550(a)(2) and maintain its listing on Nasdaq. Beginning with the opening of trading on May 9, 2025, the Company's Class A ordinary shares will trade on the Nasdaq Capital Market on a split-adjusted basis, under the same symbol "GDHG" but under a new CUSIP Number, G3959D208. As a result of the share consolidation, each 25 ordinary shares outstanding will automatically combine and convert to one issued and outstanding ordinary share without any action on the part of the shareholders. No fractional shares will be issued to any shareholders in connection with the share consolidation, and each shareholder will be entitled to receive one share of the Company in lieu of the fractional share of that class that would have resulted from the share consolidation. At the time the share consolidation is effective, the Company's authorized share capital will be changed from US$200,600,000 divided into: (i) 40,000,000,000 Class A ordinary shares of par value of US$0.005 each, and (ii) 120,000,000 Class B ordinary shares of par value of US$0.005 each, to US$200,600,000 divided into: (i) 1,600,000,000 Class A ordinary shares with a par value of US$0.125 each, and (ii) 4,800,000 Class B ordinary shares with a par value of US$0.125 each. The Company's total issued and outstanding Class A ordinary shares will be changed from 74,323,604 Class A ordinary shares with a par value of US$0.005 each to approximately 2,972,944 Class A ordinary shares with a par value of US$0.125 each. The Company's total issued and outstanding Class B ordinary shares will be changed from 1,840,000 Class B ordinary shares with a par value of US$0.005 each to approximately 73,600 Class B ordinary shares with a par value of US$0.125 each. About Golden Heaven Group Holdings Ltd. Through its Chinese operating entities, the Company manages and operates amusement parks, water parks and complementary recreational facilities. The parks offer a broad selection of exhilarating and recreational experiences, including both thrilling and family-friendly rides, water attractions, gourmet festivals, circus performances, and high-tech facilities. title: 6 formas eficaces de usar los datos históricos de Semrush
summary: Analice a los competidores y las tendencias de palabras clave desde 2012 con los datos históricos de Semrush.
body_text: Hemos traducido este artículo del inglés al español. Haz clic aquí para leer el artículo original. Si detectas algún problema en el contenido, no dudes en escribirnos a report-osteam@semrush.com . Los datos históricos de SEO permiten analizar el posicionamiento de las palabras clave, detectar cambios en el tráfico y monitorizar la actividad de la competencia. Semrush proporciona estimaciones fiables de posiciones de clasificación anteriores, volúmenes de búsqueda y mucho más, ofreciéndote el contexto que necesitas para tomar decisiones más estratégicas. Veamos seis maneras de aprovechar los datos históricos en Semrush que pueden resultarte beneficiosas. 6 maneras de usar los datos históricos de Semrush Nota: El acceso a los datos históricos solo está disponible con una suscripción Guru o superior. Si no tienes un plan Guru, puedes probarlo gratis durante siete días. 1. Diagnóstico de caídas de tráfico SEO Si experimentas una caída en el tráfico orgánico, los datos históricos pueden ayudarte a averiguar qué sucedió (y por qué). Algunas de las causas más comunes incluyen actualizaciones del algoritmo de Google, migraciones o rediseños de sitios web y cambios en el diseño de la página de resultados del motor de búsqueda (como nuevas secciones de información general basadas en IA o anuncios añadidos que desplazan los resultados orgánicos hacia abajo). En Semrush, puedes comparar el tráfico orgánico estimado de cualquier dominio a lo largo del tiempo para ver cómo ha cambiado. Comience su investigación en Investigación Orgánica . Vaya al informe “ Resumen ”, haga clic en la pestaña “ Tráfico ” y seleccione los meses deseados para ver el tráfico estimado a lo largo del tiempo. Así se puede determinar con precisión cuándo comenzó el descenso. Busque en la línea de tiempo pequeños iconos “ G ”. Esto indica actualizaciones de algoritmos conocidas. Haga clic en cualquier “ G ” para obtener detalles sobre el tipo y la fecha de actualización. También puedes buscar notas dejadas por tu equipo, que pueden explicar aspectos como cambios en el sitio, lanzamientos o migraciones. Luego, puede identificar las palabras clave asociadas con el cambio . Para ello, diríjase a la pestaña " Cambios de posición " y asegúrese de que el rango de tiempo elegido incluya los meses clave con caídas. Desplácese hacia abajo hasta la tabla de palabras clave y haga clic en el filtro “ Cambios en la SERP ” para aislar las caídas en las clasificaciones de palabras clave. Esta vista muestra qué palabras clave perdieron visibilidad debido a cambios en la página de resultados de búsqueda. Consulta la columna “Cambios en la SERP” para obtener pistas sobre qué hizo que tu contenido descendiera en los resultados. Si ninguno de los factores anteriores parece explicar el descenso, puede ser una señal de que su contenido está desactualizado. En ese caso, considere actualizar y optimizar la página para recuperar el terreno perdido. 2. Identificación de contenido con alto rendimiento previo Los datos históricos te ayudan a detectar contenido que en su momento tuvo un buen rendimiento, para que puedas revitalizarlo antes de que las cosas empeoren. Semrush te permite identificar las palabras clave que tu contenido utilizó para posicionarse bien y te da ideas sobre cómo actualizar tu página de la mejor manera. Abre la herramienta Investigación Orgánica e introduce tu dominio. Haz clic en la pestaña " Cambios de posición ". Utilice el selector de fechas para establecer un rango de fechas. Filtrar por palabras clave " Rechazado " Busca cifras que hayan disminuido significativamente en la columna "Diff."; probablemente estén relacionadas con páginas que han perdido visitas. Haz clic en cualquier palabra clave que destaque para abrirla en Resumen de palabras clave . Esto muestra datos históricos de palabras clave para ese término, incluyendo el volumen de búsqueda y la dificultad. Lo cual puede ayudarte a comprender qué puede haber cambiado. Desplácese hacia abajo hasta la sección “ Análisis SERP ” para ver qué se está clasificando actualmente para ese término. Visita algunos de los mejores resultados y observa cómo están estructurados: qué subtemas incluyen, cómo organizan la página y cuán actualizada está la información. Puedes utilizar esas ideas para guiar la actualización de tu contenido. 3. Creación de informes con contexto Los informes de SEO se centran en mostrar la mejora a lo largo del tiempo, y los datos históricos de SEO le permiten comparar sus resultados actuales con el rendimiento pasado. En concreto, los datos históricos te ayudan a: Descubre las tendencias de temporada Medir el crecimiento interanual Vincular acciones pasadas con resultados a largo plazo Comparar con la competencia en períodos de tiempo prolongados. La demostración de progreso a largo plazo ayuda a justificar la inversión continua. Antes de elaborar un informe, decida cuáles son las métricas principales sobre las que va a informar y cuál debe ser el período de tiempo que abarque. Por ejemplo, supongamos que en octubre de 2023 cambió su estrategia para centrarse más en las reseñas de productos y las guías de compra. Un año después, querrás medir el impacto de ese cambio comparando el rendimiento SEO a nivel de página entre octubre de 2023 y octubre de 2024. Abra Investigación Orgánica y haga clic en el informe “ Páginas ”. Utilice el selector de fechas para alternar entre diferentes períodos de tiempo y comparar qué URL ganaron o perdieron tráfico. Aquí está octubre de 2023: Y aquí está octubre de 2024: Estas opiniones ponen de manifiesto que el ajuste de estrategia fue efectivo. Una de las páginas de la guía recibe ahora más de 60.000 visitas. Y el año anterior, ninguna página había tenido ni siquiera 1.000 visitas. Después de identificar sus páginas con mejor rendimiento, vaya a la pestaña “ Cambios de posición ” para comprender qué movimientos de palabras clave impulsaron el crecimiento. Utilice el filtro “ Mejorado ” para identificar rápidamente los términos en los que sus clasificaciones han mejorado. Y los términos por los que estás empezando a posicionarte. En este caso, existen clasificaciones destacadas para consultas como “mejor máquina de espresso” y “máquina de espresso para el hogar”. Aquí tienes un ejemplo de informe que muestra cómo podrías presentar los cambios interanuales en el tráfico y las posiciones de las palabras clave. Podrías ampliarlo añadiendo algunas líneas de comentarios para ayudar a las partes interesadas a comprender mejor la situación: ¿Qué medidas se tomaron? ¿Qué cambios en el rendimiento fueron los más notables? ¿Cuál es el plan para el próximo trimestre? 4. Estudio del desempeño de la competencia a lo largo del tiempo Si un competidor ha estado ganando terreno o incluso superándote durante meses (o años), los datos históricos de SEO te permiten descubrir cómo lo consiguieron. Puedes explorar en detalle para ver: ¿Para qué palabras clave se posicionaban cada mes? ¿Qué páginas obtuvieron visibilidad primero? Cómo cambiaron sus clasificaciones y el tráfico estimado a lo largo del tiempo Esto puede revelar oportunidades para tu propia estrategia, ya sea utilizando palabras clave similares o aprendiendo de la estructura de su página y sus tácticas de consolidación. Para realizar un seguimiento de la trayectoria del tráfico orgánico a largo plazo de un competidor: Abra la herramienta Investigación Orgánica e ingrese el dominio de un competidor. Utilice el gráfico de tráfico de la parte superior para establecer el rango (por ejemplo, “1M”, “6M” o “Todo el tiempo”). Busque períodos de crecimiento y declive, y luego investigue qué cambió. Observa también los patrones estacionales. Una vez que hayas identificado un período de tiempo interesante, utiliza el selector de fechas para establecer ese mes. Luego, vaya a la pestaña “ Páginas ” para ver qué URL estaban generando tráfico en ese momento. Repita el procedimiento en una segunda cita, meses o incluso años después, y compare. Por ejemplo, un sitio web tenía más de 9.000 páginas orgánicas en mayo de 2021, pero un tráfico relativamente bajo. Para septiembre de 2024, el tráfico se había duplicado con creces, mientras que el número de páginas había disminuido significativamente. ¿Qué podemos deducir de esto? Dado el menor número de URL y el mayor tráfico, es probable que la empresa haya decidido eliminar páginas con poco contenido o desactualizadas, consolidar contenido similar y centrarse en menos recursos, pero de mayor calidad. Esa es una valiosa idea que quizás puedas aplicar a tu propio sitio web si se ha vuelto demasiado complejo con el tiempo. Consejo : Puedes usar la Wayback Machine para ver cómo se veía el contenido de un sitio web en diferentes momentos. 5. Comprender los patrones de palabras clave Los datos históricos sobre palabras clave te ayudan a tomar decisiones sobre qué términos utilizar basándote en más de una sola instantánea. Utilice la herramienta Resumen de palabras clave para ver cómo ha cambiado un término a lo largo del tiempo: Abre la herramienta e introduce una palabra clave que estés evaluando. Utilice el selector de fecha situado en la parte superior para cambiar los períodos de tiempo. Compara diferentes meses del mismo año (por ejemplo, febrero versus octubre). Febrero de 2023 Octubre de 2023 Esté atento a: Cambios en el volumen de búsquedas (por ejemplo, un aumento brusco) diferencias en la intención de búsqueda (por ejemplo, pasar de transaccional a comercial) La dificultad de las palabras clave aumenta (por ejemplo, debido a una mayor competencia). Esta información puede ayudarte a comprender si vale la pena utilizar una palabra clave, si se ajusta al contenido que tienes en mente y si es probable que consigas un buen posicionamiento para ese término. 6. Recuperación de datos SEO perdidos Los datos históricos de Semrush te ayudan a recuperar información valiosa sobre SEO del pasado, como tendencias de tráfico, posicionamiento de palabras clave y páginas con mejor rendimiento, incluso si ya no tienes acceso a las plataformas de SEO o herramientas de seguimiento que utilizabas anteriormente. Para comenzar, abra la herramienta Descripción general del dominio e ingrese su dominio. Utilice el selector de fechas para ver los datos de tráfico y palabras clave de meses anteriores. Encima del gráfico de tráfico, configure la vista en “Todo el tiempo ” para comprender el panorama general. Podrás ver información sobre el tráfico orgánico estimado y el total de palabras clave posicionadas a lo largo del tiempo. Desplácese hacia abajo para ver las principales palabras clave, su aparición en las funciones de la página de resultados del motor de búsqueda (SERP), la clasificación de palabras clave por intención y cómo se distribuyen las clasificaciones en las distintas posiciones. Repita este proceso cada mes que necesite para reconstruir su cronograma de SEO. Esto resulta especialmente útil al documentar esfuerzos de SEO anteriores o al comparar tendencias a largo plazo a lo largo de varios años.
